prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one small costume-texture region for a 2D skeletal rig
Primary request: Draw exactly one small screen-right/front-leg ankle-boot region as a connected flat shape. The narrow overlap tab points upper-left, the short cuff follows it, the toe points lower-left, and the heel stays at screen-right.
Design: compact dark navy fitted boot, narrow 15-percent upper overlap tab, short angular cuff, compact rounded-point toe, thin charcoal sole, short muted-purple block heel, one flat purple diamond at the ankle, and one tiny flat gold diamond immediately below it.
Rendering: clean restrained anime cel texture with uniform local colors, two hard-edged shadow/highlight areas, and a thin closed cool-black contour. Every visible mark belongs to the physical boot, connected tab, or two attached flat ornaments.
Composition/framing: exactly one complete boot, centered and uncropped on a vertical 2:3 canvas. Keep the boot deliberately small: about 25 percent of canvas width and 36 percent of canvas height, surrounded by very broad unused margins.
Constraints: single object and single view only; no second boot, pair, duplicate, alternate angle, rear-leg pose, leg, body, other clothes, detached item, extra ornament, display stand, floor, scenery, text, logo, signature, watermark, sprite sheet, atlas, turnaround, panel, grid, or inset.
